title: Insurance — acceptance checklist
note: BASELINE created 2026-07-29. Until now this module had NO acceptance list, so "completely built" had no definition and no honest percentage could be shown. Every item starts OPEN because none has been verified — this is a scope statement, not a claim of failure. M grows when new surfaces or defects appear (Rule 21). M GROWN 1 -> 6 on 2026-07-29 (Rule 21): the landing route verified live, which revealed 5 further tabs inside it. Counting the module complete on its landing surface alone would have been a wave-slice close.

items.title: Surface /insurance renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE on prod 2026-07-29 in BOTH entities. /insurance resolves to /safety/insurance and renders the Insurance Dashboard with 6 tabs (Landing, Policies, Type Catalog, Coverage Gaps, Claims, Lawsuits). TRANSP: 84 active drivers, coverage gap count 50 with a 'View gap list' drill-through. USMCA: 77 active drivers, all insurance counters 0. Entity scoping proven by the differing driver counts and gap counts.
